terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: CloudeeeIDE backend API + WebSocket server (Express/tsx) on http://localhost:3000. Bootstraps a local admin account (admin / devpassword123 by default; override via ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD).
terminals.command: DATA_DIR="$HOME/.cloud-ide" ADMIN_USERNAME="${ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}" ADMIN_PASSWORD="${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-devpassword123}" PORT=3000 npm run dev

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the React IDE frontend on http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api and /ws to the backend on port 3000).
